triggerType.description: Collapses triggerSource into manual/automated. 'automated' only for the scheduled auto-sync worker; every other source (manual trigger, retry, reconnect, webhook, initial account setup) is manual.

limitReached.description: True when the run stopped early because the workspace hit its transaction limit: rows fetched before the cut are saved, the rest were never read — so this wallet's history is incomplete. `status: partially_synced` alone does NOT mean this (a failed connector function produces the same status), which is why this is a separate field. Raising the cap does not backfill anything on its own: an incremental sync resumes from the last transaction it wrote, so the integration must be re-synced with `syncMode: resync_from_start`. This is the v2 replacement for v1's `limitExceeded`.

transactionsDeletedAt.description: Set once the transactions this run imported were deleted via `DELETE /sync/{syncId}/transactions`. The row stays in history.
